annotations.title: Compare where an asset can earn

description: Ranked comparison of the places ADA, a stablecoin or another Cardano token can earn a return, for a given amount: staking, lending pools (Liqwid, Lenfi), peer-to-peer loans (FluidTokens) and DEX liquidity pools. Each option carries the yearly rate (percent) and whether it is an APR (simple) or an APY (compounding included), what the rate was measured from and over which window, how much the venue holds, the lock-up, risk tags and the return after one year in units of the asset. Liquidity-pool rates are fee income before impermanent loss. `missingSources` names data this deployment could not read (those venues are absent, not zero) and `notCompared` the venues that are not indexed. Rates are current or past readings, not promises: say so when you quote them.

amount.description: How much of the asset, decimal-adjusted (1000 = 1,000 ADA when asset is ADA). A large amount lowers the rate of a small venue.

asset.description: What is held: "ADA", or a token unit (policy id + asset name in hex) from `search`.

name: compare_yields
